profile.name: Rahul Dubey
profile.title: Backend Developer
terminalLines: 5+ yrs building REST APIs @ scale | Node.js · NestJS · ExpressJS

summary: Backend Developer with 4.8 years of experience (Konstant Infosolutions) building scalable RESTful APIs and full-stack web applications using Node.js, NestJS, and ExpressJS. Hands-on expertise across the full project lifecycle — from architecture and API design to deployment on Linux servers with Nginx. Delivered 10+ production projects across ride-hailing, e-commerce, on-demand services, healthcare, and SaaS domains. Experienced with payment gateway integrations (Stripe, UPI), NoSQL/SQL databases, and TypeORM/Sequelize ORMs.

experience.location: Jaipur, Rajasthan · IT Services & Product Development
points: Design and develop scalable RESTful APIs using Node.js and ExpressJS, enabling seamless communication between frontend and backend across 10+ client projects.
Integrate diverse third-party APIs (maps, SMS, notifications, social auth) into production applications, reducing client integration time by standardizing reusable modules.
Implement secure payment processing workflows using Stripe and UPI, handling end-to-end transaction lifecycles including webhooks, refunds, and subscription billing.
Work across full-stack environments (Node.js, MySQL, MongoDB, HTML/CSS/Bootstrap/jQuery) on both Windows and Linux servers, deploying applications behind Nginx.
Manage database design and optimization across MongoDB and MySQL, applying TypeORM and Sequelize for clean data access layers.
Deliver SaaS, on-demand service, e-commerce, healthcare, and ride-sharing platforms — collaborating directly with clients to translate requirements into production-ready features.
Contributed to admin panel development — built CRUD functionality for user registration module using PHP.
Implemented data export feature (Excel) for admin reporting, reducing manual data extraction effort for the operations team.
Maintained continuous learning mindset to keep pace with evolving frontend and backend technologies.

projects.name: On-Demand Service Platform
projects.description: Multi-service on-demand platform supporting 10+ home service categories with real-time booking, scheduling, and Stripe payments.
points: Architected multi-service on-demand platform supporting bathing, car washing, childcare, gardening and 10+ service categories.
Built dual-interface system for customers and service providers with real-time booking, scheduling, and communication.
Integrated Stripe payment gateway with subscription and wallet functionality for premium users.

projects.name: E-Commerce Platform
projects.description: Subscription-based e-commerce platform with rewards points, wallet system, and UPI/Stripe payment integration for B2C and B2B users.
points: Developed subscription-based e-commerce platform with points rewards system, wallet, and UPI/Stripe payment integration.
Built backend agriculture buy/sell marketplace with product listing and transaction flows.
Delivered separate feature sets for business users and premium users with role-based access control.

projects.name: Tour & Travel Service
projects.description: Comprehensive travel booking app with personalized tour recommendations, guide selection, and secure Stripe payments for travelers.
points: Built comprehensive travel booking app with personalized tour recommendations based on location and budget.
Developed guide and transportation selection features with dual-platform support for guides and travelers.
Integrated Stripe for secure payment processing across all booking flows.

projects.name: Doctor / Patient Appointment App
projects.description: Appointment management system connecting therapists and patients for health checkup scheduling with a social media module for healthcare professionals.
points: Developed appointment management system connecting therapists and patients for health checkup scheduling.
Built social media module for healthcare professionals to post medical content (cancer, chronic illness awareness).

projects.name: Employee Wellbeing SaaS
projects.description: SaaS-based employee wellbeing platform with multi-tenant architecture, engagement features, and third-party wellness service integrations.
points: Contributed to SaaS-based employee wellbeing platform with multi-tenant architecture.
Built REST APIs for employee engagement features and integrated third-party wellness service providers.

projects.name: Freelance Job Platform
projects.description: Fiverr-style bidding marketplace where job seekers discover and bid on client projects with full project posting and communication workflows.
points: Built Fiverr-style bidding platform where job seekers can discover and bid on client projects.
Implemented project posting, bid management, and communication workflows between clients and freelancers.

projects.name: Smart Retail QR Engagement & Analytics Platform (Samsung)
projects.description: QR-based customer engagement platform for Samsung retail stores across India, tracking user interactions and sending real-time analytics.
points: Developed a QR-based customer engagement platform for Samsung retail stores across India.
Enabled users to scan QR codes to access AI smartphone features, videos, and product information.
Built APIs to track user interactions and send real-time analytics to the Samsung backend for store-wise visitor insights and engagement reporting.

projects.name: AI Trip Planner
projects.description: Gemini-powered trip planning feature that generates personalized itineraries and destination recommendations based on user preferences, past visits, and travel history.
points: Built an AI-powered trip planning feature using Google Gemini API to recommend location-based trips personalized to each user's preferences, past visits, and travel history.
Designed prompt pipelines that combine user profile data, past visit history, and real-time location context to generate ranked itinerary and destination suggestions via Gemini.
Integrated Gemini's recommendation output into a React.js interface for interactive trip discovery, with fallback logic for low-confidence or ambiguous responses.

projects.name: SRS RAG Assistant
projects.description: RAG-based AI assistant that lets project teams query 100+ page SRS PDFs in natural language, auto-generating module and API breakdowns to speed up sprint planning.
points: Built a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system so project teams can query 100+ page SRS PDFs in natural language instead of reading them manually.
Implemented a PDF ingestion, chunking, and embedding pipeline that stores document vectors in Pinecone for fast semantic search across SRS content.
Used Gemini to generate grounded, cited answers from retrieved SRS chunks, letting developers ask questions and get direct references back to the source document.
Extended the assistant to auto-generate module-wise and API-wise breakdowns from the SRS, cutting manual review time and speeding up sprint planning and API design.
